notes.title: Update notes for June 8
notes.content:
The game will soon add more farm elements.
- Add Hoe, Watering tool to help plants grow faster.
- Planting requires hoeing, crops will automatically align.
- Rebalancing the cooking.
- Wild animals don't fight themselves. Increasing the challenge when playing, you can't pick up meat for free anymore, simply because you want meat you have to hunt.
- Fixed flying Poop & ChickenRaw.
